## Summary

Describe the problem and the expected behavior.

## Reproduction

List the smallest reproduction, commands, and repository state.

## Evidence

Link logs, tests, or retained artifacts. Missing, blocked, or untested evidence must stay described that way.

## Tip-cite

`<8-char-main-tip> PR#<number> — <short description>`

Use the exact eight-character hexadecimal merge tip from `main` and the pull-request number when citing a merged change. Do not invent or reuse an older tip. A tip-cite records provenance only; it does not make this issue `READY`. Do not invent scores or mark untested or blocked work `READY`.
